title: Fantastic Park Güell Tour and Guide
text: We were THRILLED to see Valentina, our guide from earlier in the day, back at Park Güell in the afternoon! Her knowledge of Gaudi was back in full force as she gifted us through the park, giving us a history of the origins and showing us how important nature was to the architect. We'd love to see her again at another place in Barcelona, when we get a chance to return.
